charge_port.notes: Wikipedia: CCS Combo 1 (SAE Combo) DC inlet in North America. DC fast charging was optional on early cars (BMW US press: eligible 2014 i3s need the DC Fast Charging option; Wikipedia infobox: standard on US 2015+; BMW US 2017 release lists it as standard on the 94 Ah). Cars without the option have a J1772-only inlet and no DC. The catalogue has one trim per powertrain, so no trim split.

supercharger_access.notes: BMW Canada: Supercharger access for all BEVs except the original i3 (I01). InsideEVs: no access planned for the i3 (US).

wheels.notes: i3 4dr HB: 19 x 5 in forged aluminum, P155/70R19; no optional wheels listed.
